Custom principal import is missing from generated server code
## Problem statement
I generate my swagger server using `./swagger generate server --spec=api/swagger.yaml -P auth.Agent`. I expect the agent gets added as an argument to my handler func. This used to work fine but now the generated server doesn't compile because it doesn't import my `auth` package.

Recently, I get this:

```go
// Code generated by go-swagger; DO NOT EDIT.

package cat

// This file was generated by the swagger tool.
// Editing this file might prove futile when you re-run the generate command

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-openapi/runtime/middleware"
)

// GetCatHandlerFunc turns a function with the right signature into a get cat handler
type GetCatHandlerFunc func(GetCatParams, *auth.Agent) middleware.Responder

...
```

previously I used to get this:
```go
// Code generated by go-swagger; DO NOT EDIT.

package cat

// This file was generated by the swagger tool.
// Editing this file might prove futile when you re-run the generate command

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-openapi/runtime/middleware"
	"github.com/my/project/path/to/auth"
        // ^^^notice this is not in the previous snippet ^^^
)

// GetCatHandlerFunc turns a function with the right signature into a get cat handler
type GetCatHandlerFunc func(GetCatParams, *auth.Agent) middleware.Responder

...
```

## Environment
swagger version: 0.23.0
go version: 1.13.10
OS: macOS Mojave 10.14.6
